permission_model: governance via AGENTS.md + shared skills; native OpenCode permission system (allow/ask/deny, per-agent, bash command-level globs) available but not yet configured
known_limitations: Hook enforcement not yet deployed — OpenCode has no PreToolUse equivalent; hooks exist only via the plugin API (tool.execute.before/after in .opencode/plugins/), which the control plane has not wired

Session logging is manual — no automated trigger forces writes to .agents/session_log.jsonl; OpenCode session events (created/idle/updated/deleted) have no session.closed/ended, and session.idle semantics are not verified as equivalent to user ending the session
Governance is self-honored via AGENTS.md/skills, not enforced at the harness boundary
No real OpenCode session validation has been performed yet — Do not report as verified until a full attach+session test is run
install_steps: Optionally create project opencode.json (official schema: https://opencode.ai/config.json) with permission defaults (edit/bash/external_directory ask-mode); do not duplicate protected-paths.json rules
